display.summary: Context-menu view and edit reach the dynamic modal again, version reporting stops going stale after an update, and a placeholder SECRET_KEY no longer boots a deployment.
highlights: A host project dispatching `dlux:dynamic_modal:open` on document.body was silently ignored from 1.8.0; the listener now catches every dispatch shape.
An update no longer leaves the reported active version frozen, and an image update reports what is actually running.
A non-DEBUG deployment refuses to boot on a placeholder SECRET_KEY, which silently logged every user out when a restart resolved a different key.
Three test modules that were never in the suite now run, with a guard that fails when a test file is left unregistered.
